class.name: NetwDespawnConfig
class.description: Settings are shared by nodes using the same script. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_despawn(self).before_removal(play_death_vfx).linger(0.5) [/codeblock]

method.name: before_removal
method.description: Only the method name of [param callable] is kept. Each [NetwEntity] root calls that method before removal.

method.name: linger
method.description: Keeps the node in the tree for [param seconds] before freeing it. Sets [member linger_seconds].

members.member: Seconds the node stays in the tree before it is freed, as [constant NetwMultiplayer.ENTITY_STATE_LINGERING]. [code]0.0[/code] frees it at once.
